info.name: HR Module - NEC Middleware Copy
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for HR Module APIs in NEC Middleware. Includes Portal User Management, University Trainee Management, Political Party Agent Management, Ministry of Interior Management, and Temporary Contract Management with full CRUD operations, filtering, pagination, and status management.

item.name: Portal User Management

exec: console.log("✓ Portal User ID saved:", jsonData.data.portalUserId);

request.description:
Creates a portal user. multipart/form-data only — every field is a plain form field, plus 'photo' as the image file (jpg/jpeg/png/webp, max 5MB). No JSON body, no photoPath/photoUrl field — the server stores the file and sets photoPath itself.

masterdataId is dynamic based on portalUserTypeId:

portalUserTypeId=1 (University)     → masterdataId = university id
portalUserTypeId=2 (Political Party) → masterdataId = political party id
portalUserTypeId=3 (Ministry)        → masterdataId = ministry related id

Required fields: userName, genderId, roleId, phone, email, regionId, districtId, cityId, portalUserTypeId, masterdataId, photo
Optional: faculty, createdBy

response.name: Create Portal User
Create Portal User
Validation

request.description: Fetch a single portal user by their portalUserId (e.g. PU001).

response.name: Get Portal User by portalUserId
Get Portal User by portalUserId not found

request.description:
Fetches a paginated list of portal users with optional filters.

Available filter fields (all optional):
- portalUserId: Business ID (e.g. PU001)
- userName: Partial or full name
- phone, email: Contact filters
- genderId, roleId: Lookup IDs
- regionId, districtId, cityId: Location IDs
- portalUserTypeId, masterdataId: Type/master data IDs
- isActive: true / false

Send empty {} to get all records.

response.name: Get All Portal Users (Paginated)
Get All Portal Users (Paginated + Filtered)

request.description: Updates a portal user by portalUserId. multipart/form-data only — same flat fields as create. All fields optional, send only what needs to change. 'photo' part is optional — left disabled here by default; enable it and attach a file only when replacing the existing photo.

query.description: Set to true to activate, false to deactivate

request.description:
Changes the active status of a portal user.

Query parameter:

request.description:
Creates a new university trainee record. multipart/form-data only — every field is a plain form field, plus 'photo' as the image file (jpg/jpeg/png/webp, max 5MB). No JSON body, no photoPath field — the server stores the file and sets photoPath itself.

Required fields: fullName, genderId, age, phone, email, paymentMethodId, universityId, semester, faculty, regionId, districtId, cityId, statusId, photo
Optional: createdBy

The generated universityTraineeId (e.g. UT001) is automatically saved to the environment variable.

- pollingStationId: Polling station ID
- regionId, districtId, cityId: Location filter IDs
- statusId: Status ID
- isActive: true / false
- agentName: Partial or full agent name
- genderId: Gender ID
- phone, email: Contact filters

item.name: Ministry of Interior Management

exec: console.log("✓ Ministry of Interior ID saved:", jsonData.data.ministryofInteriorId);

request.description:
Creates a new Ministry of Interior record. multipart/form-data only — every field is a plain form field, plus 'photo' as the image file (jpg/jpeg/png/webp, max 5MB). No JSON body, no photoPath field — the server stores the file and sets photoPath itself.

Note: the name field key is 'Name' (capital N) matching the DTO.

Required fields: moiTitleId, Name, genderId, age, phone, email, regionId, districtId, cityId, vrcId, statusId, photo
Optional: createdBy

The generated ministryofInteriorId (e.g. MOI001) is automatically saved to the 'moi_id' environment variable.
